I also did not find strong evidence of a systematic state propaganda campaign in the narrow sense; the clearest record is instead one of censorship-by-pressure, detention, and intimidation of critics and journalists.","evidence":[{"title":"DR Congo: Authorities must immediately free detained journalist","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/drc-authorities-must-immediately-free-detained-journalist/","summary":"Amnesty says Stanis Bujakera’s detention was judicial harassment meant to chill criticism and other free voices.
